_comment: Screen errors that are known, reported and waiting on a decision, so
they do not turn every run red — a check that is always red stops being
read. Each entry matches a sweep error by screen, by shape (or `*`) and
by a piece of the error text; a flow's failure matches by the flow's
name in place of the screen. `api_max` limits an entry to Android API
levels up to that one. Matches are listed under their own heading in
the report, with the reason, and never fail a run. Remove an entry
when its bug is fixed: the run then fails if the error comes back.

issues.reason: the raster map nav bar (lib/widgets/raster_map_nav_bar.dart, lines 414 and 694) has a fixed height that its place chips do not fit: 6.8 px over on a 360×640 dp phone at normal text on Android, more at 1.5× text and in landscape. Needs a choice: let the bar grow, or shrink or clamp what is inside it.

the raster map nav bar (lib/widgets/raster_map_nav_bar.dart, lines 414 and 694) has a fixed height that its place chips do not fit: 6.8 px over on a 360×640 dp phone at normal text on Android, more at 1.5× text and in landscape. Needs a choice: let the bar grow, or shrink or clamp what is inside it.

Android 7.x cannot verify tile.opentopomap.org: its chain ends at ISRG Root X2, which the Android 7 trust store lacks, so map tiles never load on those phones (minSdk is 24). Fix: give the tile HTTP client a SecurityContext that also trusts the ISRG roots, or use a tile server whose chain Android 7 trusts.

issues.contains: the media library to list the seeded pictures
issues.reason: Before Android 10 photo_manager reports DATE_ADDED (when the file reached the phone) as an asset's create time, not DATE_TAKEN, so lib/services/trip_media/device_library_media_source.dart filters and sorts pictures copied over after a trip by the copy's time: on Android 7–9 the points-from-pictures screen never offers them. Needs the Android version, to fall back to the photo's EXIF there (device_info_plus, or a small platform channel).
